title: trend.get
description: Retrieve trend data according to the given parameters.

itemids.description: Return only trends with the given item IDs.

time_from.description: Return only values that have been collected after or at the given time.

time_till.description: Return only values that have been collected before or at the given time.

countOutput.description: Count the number of retrieved objects.

limit.description: Limit the amount of retrieved objects.

output.description: Set Trend object properties to be returned.
